# WaveSeparator

**Class:** `UltraCanvasWaveSeparator` · **Group:** [Layout and structure](../Groups/Layout-and-structure.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasWaveSeparator.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasWaveSeparator.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasWaveSeparator.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

The S-curve between two groups on one bar (a taskbar's system group flowing into its running apps) — one group's colour up to the curve, the next group's after it ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasWaveSeparator.md))

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasWaveSeparator> CreateWaveSeparator( const std::string& identifier, bool verticalBar, const Color& before, const Color& after, float length = 36.0f);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasWaveSeparator(const std::string& identifier, bool verticalBar, float length = 36.0f);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Options and setters

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetColors` | `void SetColors(const Color& before, const Color& after)` | The colour of the group before the separator (above on a vertical bar, left on a horizontal one) and of the group after it. |
| `SetFlipped` | `void SetFlipped(bool flip)` | Mirror the curve: on a vertical bar the S then runs from the right edge at the top to the left edge at the bottom. Purely visual; the two groups keep their sides. A bar that alternates the flip on its separators reads as one continuous wave. |
| `SetVerticalBar` | `void SetVerticalBar(bool vertical)` |  |
| `SetLength` | `void SetLength(float px)` |  |
